decisions.why: Windows PC vascular-study reporting application, not a Doppler device. Confirmed 13/09/2026 on huntleigh-diagnostics.com/products/dopplex-vascular-reporter-software/: 'Software... vascular reporting software package for use in conjunction with the Dopplex DMX, ATP and ABI kits... visualisation of waveforms on a PC and stored for reviewing, archiving and printing', with a PDF generator for interfacing to electronic patient record systems. The Vascular Assessment division's Doppler hardware correctly maps to ultrasound:hand; this named product is the reporting software that runs alongside it, fitting digital:sw instead.
